title: Какой блокчейн перспективнее: Ethereum или Solana? Анализ ChatGPT
subTitle:
Автор новости: Crypto Emergency
Ethereum (ETH) и Solana (SOL) остаются двумя наиболее заметными и активно развивающимися сетями смарт‑контрактов в криптоиндустрии. Инструмент искусственного интеллекта ChatGPT проанализировал их текущее положение и определил, какой блокчейн выглядит более перспективным в следующем году.

Модель оценивала не транзакционную активность, а факторы, влияющие на долгосрочную устойчивость: потенциальную прибыльность, институциональную привлекательность и экономику сетей.

Согласно анализу, Ethereum имеет более высокие шансы укрепить свои позиции в 2025 году благодаря эффекту обновления Dencun. Оно снизило базовые комиссии и улучшило масштабируемость за счёт активного использования роллапов. Комиссии в экосистеме Layer 2 становятся более предсказуемыми, что усиливает восприятие ETH как доходного актива.

Solana, напротив, демонстрировала рост выручки в основном за счёт розничной активности, мемкоинов и спекулятивных DeFi‑проектов — факторов, которые ChatGPT считает циклическими и менее устойчивыми.

ИИ также отмечает усиливающийся институциональный разрыв: токенизированные казначейские облигации, RWA‑решения, фонды и пилотные расчётные проекты преимущественно развиваются на Ethereum и его сетях второго уровня. Институциональные игроки выбирают платформы с юридической определённостью и зрелой инфраструктурой — а Solana пока не демонстрирует сопоставимого уровня внедрения.

Развитие Layer 2 — ещё одно преимущество Ethereum. Несмотря на мнение, что роллапы якобы «размывают» ценность сети, ChatGPT видит противоположный эффект: рост активности на втором уровне увеличивает использование блобов и, соответственно, спрос на ETH.

У Solana нет аналогичного механизма, который бы обеспечивал устойчивый спрос на токен за счёт архитектуры сети.

Предложение ETH также выглядит более благоприятным: ограниченный выпуск после «Слияния» и возможное усиление сжигания комиссий могут вернуть актив к чистой дефляции. Solana же сохраняет высокий инфляционный профиль и слабую связь между активностью и дефицитом токенов.

Тем не менее ChatGPT подчёркивает, что ситуация может измениться. Solana способна сократить разрыв, если продемонстрирует устойчивые институциональные расчёты, а Ethereum рискует потерять часть преимущества, если рост Layer 2 не приведёт к увеличению комиссий за блобы и усилению механизма сжигания ETH.

title: BTC将迎来巨大波动，圣诞周巨震预警：散户逃顶还是机构抄底？
subTitle:
随着圣诞假期临近，加密市场流动性明显走弱。尽管黄金价格创下历史新高，比特币仍维持区间震荡。

本周五市场将出现重大波动。
在12月26日，超过236亿美元的比特币期权合约将到期——这是BTC历史上最大的到期事件。数据显示，主要交易所BTC永续合约未平仓量一夜减少约30亿美元，ETH永续合约未平仓量下降约20亿美元，显示市场正在主动去杠杆而非重新加仓。

流动性收缩令市场在假期期间的双向挤压风险仍然偏高。历史上，比特币在圣诞周通常会出现5%–7%的价格波动，多与年末期权集中到期有关。
200多亿的期权在最后一周结算，按照图表观察看，也马上要临近变盘点其次还有每年专属的圣诞节行情按照以往的表现，如果圣诞节行情乐观，那么26年的一季度基本不会太差反之，如果圣诞节行情闪崩，那么26年就是地狱开局。
当前市场最大的风险点，在于高企的杠杆与假期稀薄的流动性之间的矛盾。全球主要期货交易所的比特币未平仓合约总额已攀升至约600亿美元，表明大量杠杆头寸已经建立。
如果价格在关键点位（如90，000美元）受阻回落，可能触发高杠杆多头头寸的连锁清算，从而引发剧烈的“闪崩”式下跌。这种因清算导致的抛售在低流动性环境中会被放大，这是所有交易者在节前必须警惕的“灰犀牛”。
市场的下一个关键时间窗口，将是圣诞假期后、新年伊始的交易时段。届时，机构的资金是否回归，将是决定市场能否打破当前僵局的首要因素。
在此之前，保持耐心、降低仓位、遵守纪律是穿越这场“静默风暴”的唯一法则。市场不会永远横盘，在所有人都厌倦了震荡之时，变盘的脚步可能已经悄然临近。
路哥最后总结：首先我们需要确认一点，目前市场仍处于多空分水岭阶段，比特币前期低点80600底部得到市场确认，那么在没有大的利空消息面的情况下，上下震荡调整的空间比较小，路哥判断在84000-91000这个区间，市场在经历过10月11日与11月21两次大的下跌洗筹后，在底部得到市场认可的情况下，路哥及其确信的一点，市场可能在酝酿新的趋势，但市场永远是对的，无关对错，只有看待市场的视角不同，悲观者永远正确，乐观者永远前行。#BTC  #ETH  #BTC走势分析

Liquidity contraction leaves the market with a higher risk of two-way squeezes during the holiday period. Historically, Bitcoin usually experiences a price fluctuation of 5%–7% during Christmas week, often related to the concentration of year-end options expiration.

对咱们做现货中波段的人来说，最头疼的事儿莫过于——手里的币到底是还能接着涨（二升浪、三升浪），还是已经进入主力出货期，再拿着就要被套？
 
今天分享个不看消息面、只扒技术面的笨办法，熊市里亲测管用，核心就一个：宁愿错过行情，也别踩坑被套！
 
步骤其实特简单，跟着走就行：
 
1. 先找启动点。大多币都跟着大盘走，所以直接盯大盘的启动点就行，不用单独死磕某一个币；
2. 从启动点往后看，先找第一波回调。一般都是缩量砸盘，跌得快但没多少成交量，这就是第一回调点；
3. 砸盘完反弹，这就是二升浪。等二升浪走完，会迎来第二波回调——通常是缩量砸盘后还得横盘一阵子，这就是第二回调点；
4. 横盘结束再往上冲，就是三升浪了。重点盯三升浪的顶端，别等跌了才反应过来；
5. 只要过了三升浪顶端，不管后续是震荡下行、横盘不动，还是看着像接着涨，都直接归为“绝对出货阶段”！
 
要知道，熊市里能熬到三升浪的币少得可怜，咱们做中波段图的就是稳，不是赌。所以现在就打开行情软件看看自己持有的币：要是已经过了三升浪顶端，别犹豫，要么直接卖，要么等个小反弹就赶紧出手，别抱着侥幸心理硬扛！

#zec I have used many methods in the cryptocurrency circle and have taken quite a few detours.
#ETH In the end, the method that can achieve relatively stable profits, and which I am still using now, is actually a very simple process, but it has very high execution requirements.

After a year, I managed to reach an eight-figure income through it, not relying on luck, but solely on discipline.
The core consists of four steps: selecting coins, buying, position management, and selling.

Step One: Selecting Coins
Add coins that have appeared on the rising list in the past 11 days to your watchlist.
However, there is a strict condition: if there has been a continuous decline for more than 3 days during this period, directly remove it.
This kind of trend often means that the capital has already been withdrawn after making a profit, so there is no need to enter.

Step Two: Look at the Big Cycle, Confirm the Trend
Open the monthly chart and only look at one indicator: MACD golden cross upwards.
If there is no golden cross, do not touch it. If the trend hasn't emerged, even a strong short-term move can easily reverse.

Step Three: Find Buying Points, Use Only One Line
Switch to the daily chart and only focus on the 60-day moving average.
When the coin price pulls back to the vicinity of the 60-day moving average,
and a volume surge bullish candle or a stop-loss signal appears,
only then consider entering the market.
It’s not about chasing the price up; it's about waiting for a pullback to provide an opportunity.

Step Four: Selling and Risk Control
After entering the market, use the 60-day moving average as the only standard.
Hold on while above the line, exit while below it.

Specifically, it is divided into three points:
When the price increases by more than 30%, sell one-third.
When the price increase exceeds 50%, sell another one-third.
If an unexpected situation occurs the day after buying, and the price directly falls below the 60-day moving average, exit completely without any conditions, and do not harbor any lucky thinking.

This method of combining the monthly and daily charts has a low probability of breaking below the 60-day line,
but risk control must come first.

In the cryptocurrency circle, the most important thing is not how fast you can earn, but to first keep your principal in the market.
Even if you have sold, as long as the conditions are met again, you can buy back at any time.

Ultimately, the difficulty in making money is not the method, but the execution.
The market is always changing, and stubbornness will only lead to elimination.
Understanding how to adapt is key to surviving longer in this market.#币圈暴富

#zec 我在币圈用过很多方法，也走过不少弯路。
#ETH 最后能做到相对稳定盈利、而且现在还在用的，其实是一套非常简单、但执行要求极高的流程。

一年下来，靠它做到八位数，并不靠运气，只靠纪律。
核心就四步：选币、买入、仓位管理、卖出。

第一步：选币
把近 11 天内出现过上涨榜的币加入自选。
但有一个硬性条件，如果期间出现过连续 3 天以上下跌，直接剔除。
这种走势往往意味着阶段资金已经获利撤离，没必要接。

第二步：看大周期，确认趋势
打开月线，只看一个指标：MACD 金叉向上。
不金叉，不碰。趋势没走出来，短线再强也容易翻车。

第三步：找买点，只用一条线
切到日线级别，只盯 60 日均线。
当币价回调到 60 日均线附近，
并且出现放量阳线或止跌信号，
这个位置才考虑进场。
不是追涨，而是等回调给机会。

第四步：卖出与风控
入场之后，以 60 日均线作为唯一标准。
线上持有，线下离场。

具体分三点
当一段行情涨幅超过 30%，卖出三分之一
当涨幅超过 50%，再卖出三分之一
如果买入后的第二天出现突发情况，价格直接跌破 60 日均线，无条件全部离场，不抱任何侥幸心理

这种月线结合日线的方式，跌破 60 日线的概率并不高，
但风控一定要先行。

在币圈，最重要的不是赚得多快，而是先把本金留在场内。
即便卖出了，只要再次符合条件，随时可以重新买回。

归根结底，赚钱难的不是方法，而是执行。
市场永远在变，死扛只会被淘汰。
懂得应变，才能在这个市场里走得更久。#币圈暴富

🔥Traditional assets are "hot," while the cryptocurrency market is "calm." Why?

🎄Why have gold and silver been surging to new highs, while the cryptocurrency market appears relatively tranquil? This is not coincidental; it reflects a natural selection of different asset attributes under the current macroeconomic environment.

In simple terms, this is a stark contrast between “risk aversion demand” and “risk preference” at this stage.

Gold and Silver: Driven by Dual Engines
Currently, the global macroeconomic landscape is filled with uncertainty, and geopolitical tensions combined with a high debt environment have led to unprecedented demand for traditional safe-haven assets. At the same time, clear expectations of interest rate cuts often indicate potential dollar weakness, directly boosting gold and silver priced in dollars. Additionally, silver is supported by physical industrial demand arising from the global green energy transition and AI computing power development, forming a dual narrative of “safety + growth.”

Cryptocurrency: Under Pressure Short-Term, Awaiting a Tailwind
In contrast, the cryptocurrency market, as a typical high-risk asset, is extremely sensitive to global liquidity expectations and short-term market sentiment. Before significant policy implementations or a complete clarification of macro trends, some funds tend to adopt a wait-and-see approach. Moreover, the market is experiencing profound structural changes, shifting from a previously retail-driven emotional model to a more robust institutional, fundamental, and long-term value investment logic. The growing pains of this transition period have temporarily suppressed the overall volatility in the market.

Summary and Outlook
Therefore, the current situation of “strong gold, weak coin” resembles a different allocation choice of funds at a specific stage rather than a simple “replacement” relationship. Historical experience shows that when macro uncertainty gradually fades and liquidity genuinely eases, the cryptocurrency market, as the most dynamic frontier asset class, often exhibits remarkable resilience. The market's quiet period may be a valuable opportunity for us to calmly observe and identify the main narrative thread of the next round.

简单来说，这是 “避险需求”与“风险偏好” 在当前阶段的鲜明对比。

黄金白银：双重引擎驱动
当下全球宏观经济充满不确定性，地缘政治与高债务环境让传统避险需求空前强烈。同时，明确的降息预期往往预示着美元可能走弱，这直接为以美元计价的黄金白银提供了动力。此外，白银还受到全球绿色能源转型与AI算力建设带来的实体工业需求支撑，形成了“避险+增长”的双重叙事。

加密货币：短期承压，静待东风
相比之下，加密市场作为典型的高风险资产，对全球流动性预期和短期市场情绪极为敏感。在重大政策落地或宏观趋势彻底明朗前，部分资金倾向于暂时观望。同时，市场内部也正经历深刻的结构性变化，从过去散户主导的情绪驱动，转向更稳健的机构化、基本面和长期价值投资逻辑。这种转变期的阵痛，也暂时压制了市场整体的波动热度。

总结与展望
因此，当前的“金强币弱”更像是资金在特定阶段的不同配置选择，而非简单的“替代”关系。历史经验表明，当宏观不确定性逐渐消退、流动性真正宽松时，加密市场作为最具活力的前沿资产类别，往往会展现出惊人的弹性。市场的静默期，或许正是我们冷静观察、识别下一轮叙事主线的宝贵时机。

大家觉得，下一轮驱动加密市场的主要叙事会是什么呢？是美联储的降息，还是新的技术突破？欢迎在评论区分享你的洞见！

Dù mới ở mức dự báo, thông tin này vẫn nhanh chóng thu hút sự chú ý của giới đầu tư toàn cầu. Lý do là bởi vị trí Chủ tịch Fed có ảnh hưởng trực tiếp đến định hướng chính sách tiền tệ của Mỹ, đặc biệt là các quyết định liên quan đến lãi suất, thanh khoản và điều kiện tài chính — những yếu tố then chốt chi phối tâm lý rủi ro của thị trường.
Hiện tại, các nguồn tin chỉ cho biết khả năng bổ nhiệm sớm, chưa có chi tiết về quy trình hay ứng viên chính thức. Tuy nhiên, việc Trump nhiều lần công khai chỉ trích chính sách lãi suất của Fed đương nhiệm khiến thị trường không khỏi đặt câu hỏi: liệu người kế nhiệm có mang quan điểm ôn hòa hơn, hay tiếp tục duy trì lập trường thận trọng nhằm kiểm soát lạm phát?
Ảnh hưởng tiềm năng tới thị trường crypto
Với thị trường crypto, sự kiện liên quan đến lãnh đạo Fed không tác động trực tiếp, nhưng lại ảnh hưởng mạnh thông qua kỳ vọng chính sách tiền tệ. Nếu Chủ tịch Fed mới được thị trường đánh giá là có xu hướng nới lỏng — ưu tiên cắt giảm lãi suất hoặc tạo điều kiện cho thanh khoản quay trở lại — dòng tiền rủi ro có thể được kích hoạt sớm, qua đó hỗ trợ các tài sản như Bitcoin và altcoin.
Ngược lại, trong kịch bản nhân sự mới mang quan điểm “diều hâu”, tiếp tục duy trì lãi suất cao và chính sách tiền tệ chặt chẽ, crypto có thể chịu áp lực điều chỉnh trong ngắn hạn, đặc biệt khi dòng tiền có xu hướng quay về các kênh trú ẩn an toàn.
Điểm quan trọng cần lưu ý là thị trường crypto thường phản ứng trước sự kiện chính thức. Biến động mạnh, gia tăng đầu cơ theo tin đồn và các nhịp “đánh trước – xả sau” hoàn toàn có thể xảy ra ngay cả khi quyết định bổ nhiệm chưa được công bố. Vì vậy, giai đoạn này đòi hỏi nhà đầu tư kiểm soát đòn bẩy, quản trị rủi ro chặt chẽ và theo dõi sát các tín hiệu vĩ mô thay vì chỉ chạy theo tin tức.

A Jun still remembers that summer in 2019 at the street stall, V said, "Brother, let me show you something safe."

On the table, a row of empty beer bottles was lined up, V took out his phone, the red and green candlesticks glaring in the night, "This is called a contract, I turned five thousand into fifty thousand last month, now there's a great opportunity, follow me and you'll make a profit."

At that time, A Jun was an apprentice at a car repair shop, earning three thousand two hundred a month, his father had liver cirrhosis and needed medication, and his younger sister was still in high school.

Looking at V's new iPhone, he hesitated for three days and transferred all of his wedding savings of forty-eight thousand, which he had saved for two years.

In the first month, his account grew to sixty thousand, and he treated V to hot pot, to which V patted his chest and said, "This is just the beginning."

He didn't know that V had already started to set him up and had created a "Crypto Circle Brotherhood" where people flaunted their profits and called each other "family" every day.

A Jun was completely trapped, even investing his father's medication money.

On March 12, 2020, Bitcoin plummeted by 40%, and when he woke up, his account was wiped out. V pretended to be heartbroken on the phone, urging him to raise more money to buy the dip.

A Jun borrowed online loans, sought help from relatives, and even took his sister's tuition money. It wasn't until the debt collection calls reached the shop and the boss publicly asked him to handle his personal matters that he woke up.

He went to a café to confront V, but saw him get out of a new Tesla, wearing a Rolex, with a girl sitting in the passenger seat.

A Jun simply said, "I’m done playing," and turned to leave.

Later, V bought a house in Hainan and flaunted the ocean view, while A Jun worked on cars during the day and delivered takeout at night to fill the debt hole.

Late at night, he would occasionally open the uninstalled trading software and couldn't help but think: If he had made a profit that summer, would he be the one driving an Audi? @yfkoahi

阿俊到现在都记得，2019年夏天那个大排档，V仔拍着他肩膀说“兄弟，带你玩个稳的”。

桌上空啤酒瓶摆了一排，V仔掏出手机，红红绿绿的K线在夜色里扎眼，“这叫合约，我上月五千变五万，现在有绝佳机会，跟我稳赚”。

那时阿俊汽修厂当学徒，月薪三千二，父亲肝硬化要吃药，妹妹还在读高中。

看着V仔的新苹果，他犹豫三天，把攒了两年的四万八结婚钱全转了过去。

第一个月账户涨到六万，他请V仔吃海底捞，对方拍胸脯：“这才刚开始”。

他不知道，V仔早开始对敲坑他，还建了“币圈兄弟会”，天天有人晒盈利喊“家人”。

阿俊彻底陷了，连父亲药费都投了进去。

2020年3月12日比特币暴跌40%，他醒来账户全没了。V仔电话里装痛心，让他再筹钱抄底。

阿俊借网贷、找亲戚，甚至拿了妹妹学费。直到催债电话打到厂里，老板当众让他处理私事，他才醒。

去咖啡馆堵V仔，却看见对方从新特斯拉下来，戴劳力士，副驾坐个姑娘。

阿俊只说一句“我不玩了”，转身就走。

后来V仔在海南买房晒海景，他却白天修车晚上送外卖填债务窟窿。

An Ethereum whale has completely closed a large leveraged position on Aave in a fast de-risking move.

On-chain data shared by Lookonchain shows that wallet 0xa339 sold 5,306 ETH in roughly 20 minutes, worth about $15.76 million, at an average price near $2,970. The sale was used to repay all remaining loans on Aave, removing any liquidation risk.

With the debt cleared in one sweep, the whale withdrew the rest of its collateral — around 24,700 ETH, currently valued at $74.41 million — effectively shutting down the position for good.

This wasn’t a panic exit. It was the final step in a wider risk-reduction plan that began several days earlier. On December 18, the same wallet sold 20,599 ETH for roughly $59.1 million at prices near $2,869. At its peak, the position was exposed to more than $144 million worth of ETH.

Blockchain data suggests the whale used a looping strategy, where ETH was deposited as collateral, borrowed against, and recycled to increase exposure. By selling during periods of price strength and repaying loans quickly, the trader likely locked in profits while avoiding forced liquidations.

Transaction records from Arkham Intelligence show smooth swaps, fast repayments, and minimal friction — a clear example of how large players can now manage risk efficiently using DeFi tools.

While the amount of ETH sold is small compared to daily trading volume, traders are watching closely. Whale exits often influence short-term sentiment, even when they don’t move the market directly.

For now, this looks less like a bearish signal and more like smart risk management. The whale didn’t flee Ethereum — it simply removed leverage in an uncertain macro environment.

Star Coin: A Carefully Designed Wealth Grab

False advertising hype, in early 2024, a virtual currency project called "Star Coin" went viral online. A team of scammers forged beautiful posters featuring enticing slogans like "Operated by Wall Street's top quantitative team" and "10 times returns in 30 days," along with fabricated candlestick charts showing the price "continuously skyrocketing." They extensively promoted it on short video platforms and social groups, attracting the attention of many investors.

Phishing APP trap
To invest in Star Coin, one must download their dedicated APP. This APP mimics the interface of legitimate trading platforms, featuring enticing buttons like "Invest Now" and "Recharge Rebate." To gain trust, the scammers also send forged "institution endorsement documents" and "expert recommendation videos." Many investors, tempted by high returns, gradually fell into this carefully laid trap.

Harvesting money and fleeing
When investors first entered, they could withdraw small "profits" with a small initial investment, which made them let their guard down. Once the victims increased their investments, the platform would freeze assets under reasons like "account anomalies" and "risk control review." For instance, after Ms. Wang invested 200,000 yuan, customer service requested an additional 100,000 yuan as a "guarantee deposit" to unfreeze her account, and her transaction records showed the funds ultimately flowed into personal accounts. In just a few months, over 2,000 people nationwide were scammed, with the involved amount reaching 120 million yuan.

The scam was exposed and investigated
In June 2024, the police successfully dismantled this fraud gang's den, seizing a large amount of forged blockchain codes, script dialogues, and other material evidence. Investigations revealed that the so-called "quantitative trading" was merely manual data manipulation in the background. The police remind: Any virtual currency that promises "guaranteed profits" is a scam, and it is essential to verify project qualifications through official channels, never download non-app store apps, and protect your asset security. #ETH $ETH

星辰币：一场精心设计的财富掠夺

虚假宣传造势 ，2024年初，一个名为“星辰币”的虚拟货币项目在网络上疯狂传播。骗子团队伪造了精美海报，上面印着“华尔街顶级量化团队操盘”“30天收益翻10倍”等极具诱惑力的标语，还配上了虚构的K线图，显示其价格“持续暴涨”。他们通过短视频平台和社交群组广泛推广，吸引了大量投资者的目光。

钓鱼APP设套

$HBAR price is hovering near $0.111, facing increasing downside pressure as
demand for altcoin exchange-traded products fades. With ETF inflows drying up
and technical indicators weakening, Hedera Hashgraph is struggling to attract
the institutional capital many investors expected in late 2024.
As broader crypto markets remain selective, [HBAR’s](https://www.binance.com/en/trade/HBAR_USDT?contentId=285783567&type=spot) failure to generate sustained
buying interest raises fresh questions for traders and long-term digital asset
investors.

ETF Demand Weakens: A Blow to Institutional Hopes
Hedera entered the spot crypto ETF conversation alongside several major altcoins
aiming to follow Bitcoin and Ethereum into regulated investment products. Its
enterprise-grade positioning, regulatory-friendly design, and high-profile
corporate partnerships initially fueled optimism.
However, recent ETF flow data tells a different story.
The Canary [HBAR](https://www.binance.com/en/trade/HBAR_USDT?contentId=285783567&type=spot) ETF recorded zero net inflows on December 22, highlighting a
lack of participation from both institutional and retail investors. In the
world of crypto ETF investment, consistent inflows are critical—they provide
liquidity, stabilize price action, and signal confidence from large capital
allocators.
Without that demand:
Selling pressure remains uncheckedPrice volatility increasesDownside risks accelerate during market pullbacks
For investors evaluating [HBAR](https://www.binance.com/en/trade/HBAR_USDT?contentId=285783567&type=spot) as an investment, this absence of ETF support
removes a key bullish narrative.

Why Institutions May Be Staying on the Sidelines

Several factors may explain the muted response to HBAR ETFs:
Altcoin Risk-Off Environment: Capital continues to favor Bitcoin and Ethereum, leaving smaller assets vulnerable.Liquidity Constraints: HBAR lacks the deep derivatives and options markets
institutions prefer.Brand Recognition: Despite strong technology, Hedera remains less
recognized than top-tier layer-1 competitors.Regulatory Uncertainty: Institutions may be waiting for clearer guidance
before expanding altcoin exposure.
This hesitation directly impacts HBAR price prediction models, which rely
heavily on new demand catalysts.

Technical Analysis: Bearish Structure Remains Intact

On-Balance Volume Confirms Distribution
On-balance volume (OBV), a key indicator of capital flow, has fallen to its lowest
level in nine months. This suggests sustained selling rather than
short-term profit-taking.
In practical terms:
Buyers are not stepping in aggressivelyRallies are being sold intoMarket participants lack conviction

Key Support and Resistance Levels
Resistance: $0.120 (multiple failed breakouts)Immediate Support: $0.110Next Downside Target: $0.099
A decisive break below $0.110 could trigger additional sell orders, pushing HBAR
toward the psychologically important $0.10 zone.

Can HBAR Stabilize? Bullish Scenarios to Watch
While the short-term outlook remains cautious, downside is not guaranteed.
HBAR could stabilize if:
It holds above $0.110 and enters a consolidation phaseBroader crypto markets shift back into altcoin accumulationETF flows resume, even modestlyNetwork usage or enterprise adoption metrics show acceleration
For risk-aware traders using a crypto trading platform, such consolidation zones
often precede volatility expansions—either up or down.

Is HBAR a Good Investment Right Now? 
From an investment perspective, HBAR currently sits in a high-risk, high-uncertainty zone.
Bearish factors:
Weak ETF demandProlonged downtrendDeclining volume metrics

Potential positives:
Strong underlying technologyLong-term enterprise use casesOversold technical conditions if selling exhausts

Long-term investors focused on digital asset investment may view lower price
levels as a valuation reset, while short-term traders should remain cautious
until clear demand signals emerge.

Final Thoughts: [HBAR](https://www.binance.com/en/trade/HBAR_USDT?contentId=285783567&type=spot) at a Crossroads
HBAR’s price action reflects a broader truth in crypto markets: technology alone is
not enough without capital inflows. Until ETF demand improves or buyers
regain control, Hedera remains exposed to further downside toward $0.099. 
For investors tracking HBAR price predictions, the coming weeks will be
critical. Whether HBAR finds support or breaks lower will likely depend less on
headlines and more on real capital commitment.

#ETH  Two o'clock in the morning. A fan with a grayish avatar said, "Brother, if I lose any more, I'm quitting the circle."

Only 1400U left in the account, the aftermath of the third liquidation. That kind of impatience of wanting to turn things around but fearing to miss the opportunity is something I'm very familiar with—every newcomer has experienced it.

I said, "You're not here to gamble, you're here to rebuild your account." 
For the first trade, I only let him use 10% of his position to buy ETH. He was stunned: "Just 200U? This will take ages to turn around."
I stared at him and said, "Survive first, then we can talk about turning things around." He gritted his teeth and pressed the buy button.

Three days later, the market started to rise, and the account was up 36%. I had him transfer the 600U profit to his spot account and only use the principal for trading: "Profits should be like seeds; you need to store them before they can sprout."

During that time, we were almost synchronously watching the market. He filled every page of his notebook with records, analyzing the market at three in the morning, densely packed.
1400U, 1900U, 5200U, 8700U... On the 28th day, breaking 50,000, he asked me, "Brother, am I considered a master now? Can I bring friends to trade?"

I didn’t answer, only saw him posting profit screenshots in his social circle—Is it easy to reverse in the crypto world? No, the difficulty lies in maintaining discipline.
On the 34th day, he secretly over-invested in altcoins, saying, "I watched the K-line for three days, it’s definitely going to rise."
In the end, he lost 43%. He said, "I wanted to test my judgment."

At that moment, what I saw was not courage, but a familiar impulse—the shadow of liquidation came back.

On the 36th day, I blocked him. The account still had 28,000U left, not because I was heartbroken over the money, but because I watched him throw away "diversification, stop-loss, rolling positions" into the trash. The habits formed over 28 days were no match for the inner demon wanting to prove himself.

The harshest truth in the crypto world: Making 50,000 from 1400U is not hard; what’s difficult is maintaining the discipline to continue.

Those who can truly survive do not rely on one-time big profits, but rather engrave discipline into their bones.

title: Why Crypto Is Falling Today — and Why Raoul Pal Says This Dip Matters
subTitle:
Global crypto markets fell today, with Bitcoin and altcoins trading lower. Bitcoin slipped below $88,000 after briefly moving above $90,000 earlier in the day. Ethereum also dropped back under $3,000, while most large-cap altcoins traded in the red.
One of the drivers of the decline is the upcoming expiry of more than $28.5 billion worth of Bitcoin and Ethereum options on Deribit later this week. This is the largest options expiry in the exchange’s history and represents over half of its total open interest.
Such large expiries often increase short-term volatility as traders adjust or roll positions. Additionally, the $96,000 level is Bitcoin’s “maximum pain” point, where options sellers benefit most, while heavy put interest around $85,000 could pull prices lower if selling pressure increases.
Adding to the pressure, U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded net outflows of about $142 million on December 22.
Broader market indicators also point to stress. The Crypto Fear and Greed Index fell to 29, firmly in the “fear” zone. Altcoin dominance momentum, measured by monthly RSI, has dropped to an all-time low, showing weak appetite for riskier tokens.
Raoul Pal says dip zone is forming
Despite the pullback, Raoul Pal, founder of Real Vision, said he believes the market is entering a buying zone rather than a new downtrend.
Pal said crypto was hit hard as liquidity was temporarily withdrawn from the system, exposing excessive leverage. However, he said that prices are now stabilizing around prior lows, a pattern that often means a base forming.
Looking ahead, Pal expects a surge in global liquidity once year-end funding pressures ease and policy conditions loosen, arguing that investors do not need to catch the exact bottom to benefit from the next move higher.
“Crypto reacts first when liquidity tightens, and it recovers first when liquidity returns,” he said, adding that the current weakness fits that pattern.

Miner capitulation is a contrarian signal, indicates renewed bitcoin momentum, VanEck says

VanEck data shows declining bitcoin mining activity has historically preceded strong returns in bitcoin.

What to know:

VanEck data shows that in the past 30 days bitcoin’s hashrate dropped by the most since April 2024

Hashrate declines are historically aligned with miner capitulation and markets closer to local bottoms than tops.

According to VanEck, periods of negative 90-day hashrate growth have delivered positive 180-day bitcoin returns 77% of the time.

Declining bitcoin BTC$87,557.99 mining activity is often interpreted as a sign of network stress, reflecting weaker miner profitability, declining hashrate and concerns over the economic sustainability of mining operations. It is commonly assumed to be bad for the bitcoin price.

Digital assets investment firm VanEck, however, argues that periods of falling hashrate — the total computational power being used by miners to secure the bitcoin network and process transactions — has historically functioned as a contrarian indicator, indicating improving price momentum rather than a signal of structural weakness.

This dynamic is emerging as bitcoin trades around $87,000, following a 36% peak-to-trough slide from the October's all-time high.

Over the past 30 days, bitcoin's network hashrate recorded its steepest decline since April 2024, as miners faced compressed margins from a weaker BTC price and that month's "halving," an event that cuts block rewards by 50% roughly every four years, reducing new bitcoin issuance.

Subsidies should be distributed to specific groups rather than revolving around large companies with year-round subsidies, which seems very reasonable, and this kind of long-term targeted subsidy has also broken the original commercial balance.

In fact, the production of GDP does not occupy a high proportion in the economic structure, even domestically it is only about 30%. The method of providing targeted subsidies to certain companies seems to prevent flooding and inflation. In reality, long-term subsidies to companies that are already in the same market create an oligopolistic subsidy. For example, if someone is torn between choosing Xiaomi and a certain second-tier brand due to a 500 yuan difference, and a 500 subsidy is introduced, their original consumption expectation would directly shift to Xiaomi. Moreover, the subsidy money does not have much effect on companies that maintain competitiveness; instead, it gives them the confidence to disrupt other industries during the dividend period. Over time, the domestic commercial structure has formed internal competition, breaking the commercial balance, and its effect is negligible.

Targeted subsidies are meaningless when given to the supply side. Subsidies provided to some large enterprises for products do not lead to an increase in employees; instead, companies may choose to lay off workers due to industrial restructuring, and then get involved in the next more competitive field with subsidies.

In the past five years, bank savings and the income of ordinary classes can fully verify that long-term targeted subsidies to companies do not yield a good economic environment.

quoteContent.title: Polymarket出逃Polygon背后的经济账
quoteContent.bodyTextOnly:
原创 | Odaily 星球日报（@OdailyChina）

作者｜Azuma（@azuma_eth）

12 月 22 日，一则关于预测市场龙头 Polymarket 的动态引发了市场普遍关注 —— Polymarket 团队成员 Mustafa 于 Discord 社区内确认，Polymarket 计划从 Polygon 迁移，并推出名为 POLY 的以太坊 Layer2 网络，这是该项目当前的首要任务。

一场并不意外的“分手”

Polymarket 选择跳出 Polygon 并不算令人意外，一个是当红炸子鸡的应用层代表，一个是日渐式微的旧底层，二者之间的市场热度和价值预期本就有些错配。随着 Polymarket 逐渐成长为新的巨兽，Polygon 不够稳定的网络表现（最近一次故障出现于 12 月 18 日）以及相对贫弱的生态客观上已构成了对前者的限制。

对于 Polymarket 而言，自建门户意味着产品和经济两个维度上的双赢选择。

产品方面，除去寻求更稳定的运行环境外，自建 Layer2 网络可帮助 Polymarket 根据其平台需求去反向定制底层特性，从而更灵活地适配平台未来的升级与迭代。

而更重要的意义，则体现在经济层面。自建网络意味着 Polymarket 可以将围绕其平台所衍生的经济活动及周边服务一并收拢进自身体系，阻止相关价值外溢至外部网络，而是逐步沉淀为自身的系统性优势。

显性与隐性的经济贡献

作为应用层，Polymarket 的爆火曾经为 Polygon 带来了客观的直接经济贡献，数据分析师 dash 于 Dune 整理的数据历史显示：

Polymarket 本月活跃用户数为 419309 人，历史总用户数为 1766193 人；

本月总交易笔数为 1963 万笔，历史总交易笔数为 1.15 亿笔；

本月总交易量为 15.38 亿美元，历史总交易量为 143 亿美元。

至于该如何去评估 Polymarket 对于 Polygon 生态经济的贡献占比，Odaily 星球日报在整理二者数据时发现了一个颇为巧合的比例。

首先是沉淀资金方面，Defillama 数据显示当前 Polymarket 全平台头寸总值约为 3.26 亿美元，约占 Polygon 全网锁仓总值 11.9 亿美元的四分之一；

其次是 gas 消耗状况，Coin Metrics 去年十月曾统计称与 Polymarket 相关的交易预计消耗了 Polygon 全网 25% 的 gas；

考虑到该数据偏久，我们又检查了近期的变化情况，数据分析师 petertherock 于 Dune 绘制的统计显示 11 月 Polymarket 相关的交易合计消耗了约 21.6 万美元的 gas，而 Token Terminal 则统计显示当月 Polygon 全网 gas 总消耗量约为 93.9 万美元，比例同样接近四分之一（约 23%）。

这里固然可能存在因统计口径与时间窗口造成的巧合，但跨维度的相似结果在一定程度上也可作为衡量 Polymarket 对于 Polygon 经济意义的估算参考。

除了活跃用户、沉淀资金、交易流水、gas 贡献等可量化指标之外，Polymarket 对 Polygon 的经济意义，还体现在一系列更难被直接衡量、却同样真实存在的隐性贡献之中。

首先是对稳定币流动性的盘活。Polymarket 的所有交易均以 USDC 结算，其高频、持续的交易行为在客观上显著提升了 USDC 在 Polygon 网络上的流转需求与使用场景；其次是留存用户的附带行为价值，除去预测市场本身之外，这些用户也有可能出于便利而转向使用 Polygon 生态上的 DeFi 等其他产品，进而提升 Polygon 网络的整体生态价值。这些贡献很具体的数据去量化，却构成了底层网络最为看重、也最为稀缺的“真实需求”。

为什么是现在？答案并不难猜

事实上，仅从用户规模、数据表现及市场声量来看，Polymarket 已完全具备了自立门户的底气。这早已不是一个“该不该走”的问题，而是一个“什么时候走”的问题。

之所以选择在当下这个时间点着手迁移，核心原因或在于 Polymarket TGE 的临近。一方面， Polymarket 一旦完成发币，其治理结构、激励体系与经济模型都会相对固化，后续再进行底层迁移的成本与复杂度将显著上升；另一方面，从“单一应用”升级为“应用 + 底层”的全栈系统，本身就意味着估值逻辑的变更，自建 Layer2 无疑为 Polymarket 在叙事与资本层面打开了更高的天花板。

总而言之，Polymarket 出走 Polygon，本质上并不仅仅是一次简单的底层迁移，而是加密行业结构性变化的缩影。当顶级应用开始具备独立承载用户、流量与经济活动的能力，底层网络若无法提供额外价值，就不可避免地会被“背刺”。

无他，逐利而已。

On December 22, a dynamic regarding the leading prediction market Polymarket attracted widespread market attention — Polymarket team member Mustafa confirmed in the Discord community that Polymarket plans to migrate from Polygon and launch an Ethereum Layer2 network named POLY, which is currently the project's top priority.

刚瞅见突发消息，美联储之前拖着没公布的GDP报告，今儿上午8:30（美东时间）终于要亮相了。这份数据极有可能直接给市场短期走势定个基调。当下市场基本都按3.2%左右来预估，行情也差不多提前把这个预期消化了。可重点在于，实际公布的数据会偏向哪个方向？

要是实际数据小于3.1%，那就是经济明显降温的信号，市场就会开始押注降息，这对风险资产来说是好事。

要是实际数据正好等于3.2%，跟市场预期一致，那行情大概率会震荡，别想着能有大动静。

要是实际数据大于3.3%，那市场就会担心经济过热，美联储可能更不敢降息，流动性预期收紧，对市场整体偏不利。

这简直就是一场数据左右市场情绪的博弈。特别是最近市场流动性不太好，任何超出预期的结果，都可能让市场波动加剧。我觉得这次GDP数据，不能光看数字本身，更得关注市场怎么解读。

毕竟在“经济好就延迟降息”这个逻辑还说得通的阶段，就算数据挺好，要是引发了市场对紧缩的担忧，反而可能让市场下跌。

我建议大家在数据公布前后别瞎操作，特别是玩合约的，小心价格突然大幅波动，被“插针”了。等市场把情绪消化完，走出明确方向后，再考虑要不要跟着操作。
